intro: Round three. After a first business (age 18–28) and a second (38–48, now in liquidation), Delivery Pilot is built on the lessons of both. Three audiences, three offers, one mission: free for students, a monthly membership for professionals, and a managed service for businesses, built on the Delivery Pilot bot product.

tiers.name: Students
tiers.who: Students and career switchers starting out
get: The full Delivery Pilot course on YouTube and Skool
The free Skool community and the Sunday live cohort
The 90-day flight plan: specs → one agent → certification
tiers.why: Retool people early, with no barrier. Today's students are tomorrow's professionals and certified pilots.
tiers.revenue: No direct revenue. Builds the audience, the reputation and the talent pool.

tiers.name: Professionals
tiers.who: Working developers, DevOps/SRE engineers and tech leads moving up a seat
get: Weekly live clinics and workflow debugging
Production templates: n8n workflows, agent configs, Docker packs
tiers.why: Professionals pay to save time and level up faster. The price matches the existing plan's paid Skool tier.

tiers.name: Businesses
tiers.who: Companies that want AI agents delivering real work, without hiring a team to run them
get: Delivery Pilot bots built for their workflows
Run, monitored and improved for them: a managed service on top of the bot product
Delivered by certified pilots, with SRE-grade reliability
tiers.why: Businesses buy outcomes, not courses. Your 40+ delivered contracts and migration work make this credible.
tiers.revenue: Setup fee plus monthly retainer. The highest value per customer.

flywheel.title: 🔁 The flywheel
steps: 🏅 The best get certified as Delivery Pilots
🤖 Certified pilots build and run bots
🏢 Businesses pay for the managed service
💸 Revenue funds free education for more students
flywheel.note: This matches what you already say on camera: certified pilots go on to build real bots for real companies.

scenario.title: 🧮 Illustrative monthly scenario
scenario.note: Assumptions to test, not forecasts. Change the numbers in data/business.json.

assumptions: 💼 $49/month is taken from the existing business plan (paid Skool tier).
🏢 The $1,500/month average retainer is an assumption. Validate it with 2–3 discovery calls before publishing a price.
🎓 500 free members is the OKR target (+500 Skool members).
📉 AdSense, sponsorships and digital assets come on top. See the Money section on the dashboard.
